xhs.title: Amazon's silent badge
xhs.opening_hook: Your Amazon listing might already wear an invisible badge that drops conversion 20-40% — and the platform won't notify you.
xhs.content:
Your Amazon listing might already wear an invisible badge that drops conversion 20-40% — and the platform won't notify you.

It's called Frequently Returned. Amazon attaches it to the product detail page when a SKU's return rate exceeds the category baseline. Every shopper sees it. Many close the tab.

What triggers it (swipe through the carousel for the full breakdown):
• Return rate above category average
• Returns clustering around "not as described" or "quality issues"
• Post-promo return spikes that push the rate over the line

Once on, removal takes weeks of below-average returns. Prime Day 2026 is roughly 5 weeks out. If a SKU is borderline, you don't have time to fix it AND prove the fix before Prime Day amplifies the problem.

Three things to do this week:

1. Pull the FBA returns report. For every SKU, log return rate and the top 3 return reasons.
2. SKUs above category average → fix the detail page first (real photos, sizing chart, materials).
3. Persistently broken SKUs → pause ads or remove before Prime Day amplifies them.

Save this carousel for your next ops meeting. Follow for the 10% of Amazon news that actually moves PnL.
